name: Verify Minimum TE
description: MY-RADS specifies minimum TE for DWI to maximize SNR. Ultra-high b-values require longer TE which degrades image quality. (From the MY-RADS Myeloma Whole-Body MRI Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
te = value["EchoTime"].dropna()
if len(te) > 0:
    te_val = te.iloc[0]
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Echo Time is {te_val} ms. MY-RADS specifies minimum TE should be used for DWI. Verify this is the minimum TE available for your sequence - longer TE results in T2 decay and reduced SNR.")

testCases.name: TE always warns
testCases.description: Always warns to verify minimum TE
